description: Leitungsnetz Trinkwasser - WAV Osterholz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Presentation of the pipeline network for drinking water supply in the area of the Water and Wastewater Association Osterholz. Contains information on main lines, house connections, hydrants and gate valves. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Pipeline network drinking water - WAV Osterholz" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasserversorgung, inspireidentifiziert. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
